thread:
maria-v: Wrapping up the DR postmortem follow-ups. I pulled the recurring failure patterns from the incident log (INC-4212, INC-4298) and sketched owners + quick deliverables so we can close loop before the rehearsal. Please claim or reassign.

hao: I'll take lead on the routing policy audit and regional failover matrix. Will audit current route weights + fallback rules and push a short doc. ETA Mon EOD (2067975000).

lin: I'll own the automated restore smoke job and retention policy decision. Running a full restore Tuesday morning against a scrubbed snapshot. Will post the checksum and failure-mode notes.

emily: I'll update the restore runbook language to include an "if X happens" decision tree (KV cache stale, partial bundle restore). Also adding the observability pre-check list. Draft by Wed.

maria-v: Good. Two new cautions from the postmortem: 1) repeated partial KV-cache misses during cutover, 2) backup metadata drift in eu regions. Please make sure tests cover those.

hao: For KV-cache I'll include a validation step in the harness: after traffic-shift, run a read-consistency probe across both regions for 10k keys. Failure criteria: >0.1% misread rate.

lin: For backups I'll add a metadata checksum verification and a small script to diff manifest.json across regions. Sample command to add to the runbook:

```
# verify snapshot manifest parity
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/prod/manifest.json - | jq -S . > /tmp/manifest-us.json
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/eu/manifest.json - | jq -S . > /tmp/manifest-eu.json
diff -u /tmp/manifest-us.json /tmp/manifest-eu.json || echo "manifest drift detected"
```

emily: Runbook checklist items I'm adding: 1) confirm latest snapshot ID & checksum, 2) confirm KMS policy grants, 3) run manifest parity check, 4) warm read-only traffic to target region, 5) validate business-critical endpoints. Trying to keep each step <2 minutes.

hao: I'll also produce a short matrix of traffic-shift scenarios: gradual 30m, abrupt cutover, and circuit-breaker fallback. Will include expected latency/regression numbers to watch.

maria-v: Owners & timelines (single place):
- Routing audit + failover matrix: hao  PR by 2067975000
- Restore smoke job + retention proposal: lin  verify Wed 2068050000
- Runbook edits + observability pre-check: emily  draft by 2068125000
- Game-day rehearsal scheduling: maria-v  invites today

lin: I'll post the restore logs and checksum here after the test. If anything fails I'll open an incident card and tag owners.

emily: Adding a saved dashboard view: region_p95, error_rate, manifest_drift_alert_count, kv_mismatch_rate. Will add direct links in the runbook PR.

ops-bot: Reminder: DR game-day rehearsal scheduled 2025-12-03 13:00 UTC  Duration: 90m. RSVP required.

maria-v: One more ask  add a short post-failure retrospective note to the runbook: where to look when restore takes >30m and who to call. Also include escalation contacts for KMS/team.

hao: Will add the escalation matrix and point to on-call rotation.

lin: Test scheduled Tue 07:00 UTC. Will report results here.

emily: I'll push the runbook PR and tag for two reviewers; auto-merge after approvals.

maria-v: Thanks all. Treat these as sprint deliverables for the next 6 working days. If there are no objections I'll close this thread and create action cards in the incident tracker. :thumbsup:

hao: SGTM.

lin: SGTM.

emily: SGTM.
